criteria: Identification of 'Hard Delete' Propagation Strategy from Primary CRM.

criteria: Prevention of the 'Thundering Herd' Problem on SSE Cache Invalidation.
hint: Outline how the silent background refetches are staggered when an SSE invalidation payload broadcasts to hundreds of active UI sessions globally at the same instance.
placeholder: Define staggering or jitter logic for refetching...

references.info: FR-002: Real-time UI Streaming Pipeline causing silent background refetches across active client React components.

additional_info: Simultaneous refetch spikes can crash the read nodes instantly.

criteria: UI Graceful Handling of AWS S3 Expired Artifacts.
hint: Given ASI dictates S3 artifacts expire after 24 hours, determine if users clicking an old export link see a raw AWS XML error or if the application intercepts to display a 'Report Expired' UI.

references.info: ASI-000002: AWS S3 Data Retention Policy dictates short-lived artifacts.

additional_info: Raw AWS XML errors degrade User Experience (UX) severely.

criteria: UX Indication for Redis Degradation Fallback (Slow Queries).
hint: If the system triggers the 'Failover Degradation' hitting MongoDB directly due to a Redis OOM, does the UI show a 'Performance Degraded' warning, or does it silently spin a loader for 20 seconds?
placeholder: Specify UI state during degraded backend performance...

references.info: FR-007: Redis Cache Failover Degradation bypassing cache during crashes.

additional_info: Without a visual warning, Users will assume the application froze and will repeatedly refresh, worsening the DB crash.
